info.title: Townsquare API
info.description: Schedule WhatsApp posts to groups, communities, channels and Status. Everything the web app can do. Read the agent guide at /api/v1/guide.md first. All changes are recorded in history and can be undone.

tags.name: Status
tags.description: Start here: connection, safe mode, your key's scope.

tags.name: Posts
tags.description: Create, edit, schedule, pause, send now. Targets accept names.

tags.name: Sends
tags.description: Individual occurrences on the calendar: list, move, copy, skip, deliveries.

tags.name: Targets
tags.description: Groups, community announcement groups, channels, Status and yourself.

tags.name: Media
tags.description: Upload by file or URL; converted for WhatsApp.

tags.name: Clients
tags.description: Group posts and chats by client.

tags.name: Sets
tags.description: Named lists of chats to add in one go.

tags.name: History
tags.description: Who changed what; undo and redo.

tags.name: Settings
tags.description: Time zone, safe mode, pacing, quiet hours.

tags.name: Telegram
tags.description: Log in as your Telegram account and list your groups and channels.

tags.name: Stats
tags.description: Engagement: reads, views, reactions, replies, shares and member growth for what Townsquare sent.

tags.name: WhatsApp
tags.description: Link or unlink your WhatsApp account from the browser or an agent.

tags.name: System
tags.description: Version, signed self-updates, start at login, and stopping the server.

get.description: Connection, safe mode, today's count, time zone, and your key's scope. Call this first.

patch.description: Set client (null clears), star, or allowlist (admin).
Partial update, including per-client quiet hours.

post.description: Multipart field `file`, or JSON {"url": ..., "kind"?: image|video|voice|audio|document}. Converted for WhatsApp (ffmpeg).
Targets may be names. Posts are drafts unless status is "scheduled", even with a time (the response then includes a notice).
One action on many posts, recorded as a single undoable change. tag/client: pass tag_id/client_id (null clears).
Validate, resolve targets and list the next sends. Saves nothing.

patch.description: Partial update. For repeating posts set scope (one/future/all).

delete.description: scope=one skips a single send; future stops the series from occ.

get.summary: List upcoming sends of a post

post.description: Adds a one-off send at the current minute; the send loop picks it up within 15 s. Safe mode still applies.
Creates a draft copy without times.
scope=one moves only this send; all shifts the whole series.
Creates a new one-off post at `to`.
Reverts the latest undoable change by anyone. Pass expect_change to be safe.

expect_change.description: Only undo if this change is still the latest

post.description: Sends now to your own chat only: WhatsApp Message yourself, or Telegram Saved Messages.
Admin. Then show GET /telegram/qr.png and scan it in Telegram: Settings > Devices > Link Desktop Device.

get.description: Admin. PNG of the current login QR. It refreshes about every 30 seconds while a login is running.

Everything on the stats board: tiles (with the previous period for comparison), daily reach and delivery health, read speed, best-time heat map (weekday Monday=0 by hour), breakdowns by type, tag, client and app, chats with trends, top reactions, and Telegram's own channel insights. Counting starts with sends made after this feature shipped.

Per-chat numbers for a post's sends, cumulative reads per hour for 48 hours, reactions, and (when stats_people is on) who read, reacted or replied.

parameters.description: Comma list of client ids; 0 = no client

post.description: Sends the text summary right away. Takes the same filters as /stats/summary in the query string.

to.description: "me" (default, your own chat) or a chat jid. Safe mode limits this to allowlisted chats.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Comma list of tag ids; 0 = no tag

parameters.name: client
parameters.description: Comma list of client ids; 0 = no client

post.description: Fetches and verifies the newest release's signed manifest. Downloads nothing.

Admin. Downloads the newest release, checks its signature and hash, and restarts into it. Refuses (409 busy) when a post is due within 15 minutes unless force is true, and (409 built_from_source) on builds from source.

force.description: Restart even when a post is due within 15 minutes

put.description: Admin. macOS LaunchAgent, Linux systemd user service, or Windows Run key. Takes effect at the next login.

post.description: Admin. Stops the server. A service manager (launchd, systemd) may start it again.
Admin. Then show GET /whatsapp/qr.png and scan it in WhatsApp: Settings > Linked devices > Link a device. Codes refresh for up to 10 minutes.

phone.description: Optional, with country code, for a typed pairing code

get.description: Admin. PNG of the current link QR while linking.

post.description: Admin. Removes this linked device from your WhatsApp account.
Admin. Saves the api_id and api_hash from my.telegram.org (API development tools) and starts Telegram. Then log in with /telegram/login.

bearer.description: API key from Settings → API keys (tsq_...)

Settings.description: All values are strings. safe_mode is "1" or "0"; times are HH:MM; gaps in seconds; grace in minutes. Changing safe_mode needs admin scope.

jid.description: WhatsApp JID; Telegram: tg:self, tg:chat:<id>, tg:ch:<id>:<hash>, tg:ch:<id>:<hash>:t<topic>, tg:story:self, tg:story:ch:<id>:<hash>; bot: tgbot:<chat id>

quiet_start.description: HH:MM. Empty = use the global quiet hours. Equal to quiet_end = no quiet hours.

timezone.description: Zone for the quiet hours; empty = the app's zone

ClientInput.description: Quiet hours apply to chats assigned to this client (and to posts with this client when the chat has none).

staged.description: Downloaded version that starts on the next restart

dev.description: Built from source: updates are reported, never installed

app_mode.description: Started by opening the app (offers Quit)

configured.description: telegram.app (api_id, api_hash) exists on the server

queue_hours.description: 0 = off; otherwise Telegram sends due within this many hours are handed to Telegram's own scheduled queue

Override.description: A per-send exception on a repeating schedule

id.description: Keep when editing so deliveries stay linked

media.description: Media ids from POST /media; each is sent as its own message, caption on the first

status.description: Default: draft (even with a time). Set scheduled to send.

send_at.description: Shortcut for one send: RFC 3339, or local YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM in tz

tz.description: Zone for send_at and schedules without tz. Default: the app's time zone

media.description: Media ids from POST /media; each is sent as its own message, caption on the first

status.description: Default: draft (even with a time). Set scheduled to send.

send_at.description: Shortcut for one send: RFC 3339, or local YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM in tz

tz.description: Zone for send_at and schedules without tz. Default: the app's time zone

scope.description: Repeating posts: which sends to change. Default all

schedule_id.description: With scope one/future: the schedule of the send

occ.description: With scope one/future: the send's original local time (from GET /sends)

at.description: scope=one: new local time for this send

at_tz.description: Zone of at; default the app's zone

PostPatch.description: Send only the fields to change. status: draft, scheduled (sends), paused or archived.

change.description: History id of this change; pass to POST /undo as expect_change. For undo/redo: the new history entry

undid.description: Undo only: the change that was reverted

redid.description: Redo only: the change that was re-applied

notice.description: Create only: present when a post with a time was saved as a draft because no status was given

E422.description: Invalid input (message explains what to fix)
